newsitem.title: USA: Acer to supply parts for Mac, clones.
newsitem.headline: Acer to supply parts for Mac, clones.

text.p: Acer Inc, the Taiwan-based computer maker, said Thursday it has clinched a deal to supply components for Macintosh-compatible computer makers, including motherboards and other major parts, on a worldwide basis.
Acer said it will act both as original equipment manufacturer (OEM) supplier for Apple Computer Inc, which makes Macintosh systems, as well as for Macintosh clone makers.
"We are confident that Acer will serve as a strong support resource, and together, Acer and Apple will be a powerful force," said Stan Shih, Acer's chairman and chief executive.
The Acer group had combined revenues of $5.8 billion in 1995 and is ranked the world's seventh largest personal computer manufacturer.
